entries.reason: Compose the optional ledger-backed resume manager with configured auto-resume, TTL, suspension hook and orderly waiter cleanup.
entries.contract: The same admitted request service owns automatic, bare-trigger and control resume; no ledger leaves resume unavailable without disabling Stop or Steer.
entries.invariant: No live state or resume on restart; async resume never holds a journal transaction across await and does not block Stop.

entries.reason: Adapt retained resume execution to the trusted desktop request-service handoff while keeping upstream trigger recognition and checkpoint checks.
entries.contract: Automatic capacity and monotonic-session admission still run before original-message, current-policy, budget and single-winner-lease checks.

entries.reason: Use existing generation-bound guarded control admission for bare-command intake and deliver original Odin refusal wording.
entries.contract: Both explicit entry paths resume the preserved request through RequestService with admitted context, next generation and durable delivery.
entries.invariant: Unknown operations halt without a model call; current owner, queue, lease and quiescing checks remain authoritative.

entries.reason: Recognize exact preserved-work resume commands before model prompt/history construction and dispatch through guarded original-request admission.
entries.contract: Recognized commands are consumed, delivered refusal notices use Odin wording, semantic submission identities are durable and never fall through to fresh execution.
entries.invariant: Ordinary sentences and triggers with no preserved work retain normal submission behavior; reset fencing, attachment authority and no-replay remain intact.

entries.reason: Prove capacity-recovery auto-resume through the actual wired core, admitted request service and retained runner.
entries.contract: Recovery publishes generation-two reply; newer conversation activity and configured auto-resume false stand the waiter down.
entries.invariant: Only deterministic harmless providers, disposable profile stores and isolated test namespaces.

entries.reason: Prove exact bare-trigger resume, refusal notices and ordinary-message distinctions via real request intake.
entries.contract: Continue resumes original generation-two work without a user transcript entry; unresolved operations make no new model call.
entries.invariant: No real tool effect is performed and recognized commands cannot start fresh work on refusal.

entries.reason: Exercise disabled and failed-open durability after a real suspended checkpoint and profile reload.
entries.contract: Control resume returns durable resume_unavailable refusal while Stop and Steer admit and settle on legacy work.
entries.invariant: No manager is built without a ledger; no unknown control outcome or synthetic production effects.
